messages:
Nora: Quick thread on confirm UX for destructive actions and validation microcopy. Want a small, accessible pattern for console forms. Main questions: 1) when to require type-to-confirm vs simple modal, 2) exact copy for prompts, 3) keyboard focus behavior.
Ibrahim: For infra resources: require type-to-confirm when deletion is irreversible or cross-account. Otherwise simple modal with clear scope is fine.
Clara: Copy idea A: "Type the resource name to confirm deletion:" B: "This action cannot be undone. Type DELETE to confirm." Which is clearer?
Mike: A is clearer and ties to resource identity; B is faster for users but less specific. Prefer A when resource names are unique and important.
Nora: Accessibility: ensure the confirm input receives focus, has aria-label="confirm resource name", and make the dialog role="alertdialog" with aria-describedby pointing to the warning text.
Ibrahim: Also add visually-hidden hint for screen readers: "After typing, press Enter to confirm or Esc to cancel."
Clara: On placeholder vs label: never use placeholder as only label. Use persistent label + hint text below.
Mike: Validation for type-to-confirm: exact-match only. Allow trimming whitespace but case-sensitive? Thoughts.
Nora: Case-insensitive comparison for long resource names causes accidental matches; I'd prefer exact with case-sensitive when names are case-sensitive in system. If not, normalize both sides and show a small helper: "Match is case-insensitive".
Ibrahim: Good point. Also show a small strength indicator when resource name is autogenerated or very long so people can copy-paste.
Clara: For inline form validation: on blur show error, on input clear error but don't revalidate until blur to avoid interrupting typing. For submit, show top summary with numbered list and anchors.
Mike: UX nit: don't disable primary CTA while editing; let users click but show modal with inline errors after submit. Disabled CTA can hide how to fix things.
Nora: Keyboard flow: when summary appears, move focus to summary and include a skip link: "Jump to first error". Also provide a close button with aria-label.
DesignBot: New mocks: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/confirm-patterns-v2 ":thumbsup:"
Ibrahim: Microcopy templates for design system: 1) Simple confirm header: "Confirm deletion" 2) Body: "This will permanently delete [resource-type] "3) Type-to-confirm prompt: "Type "[resource-name]" to confirm" 4) Low-risk modal: bold warning + Cancel / Delete.
Clara: Can someone add the aria examples to the design docs? I'll review the PR.
Mike: I'll add keyboard/focus test cases to the QA checklist.
Nora: Great, let's land this as the default pattern for next console sprint. Thanks!
